description: Multi-tap delay: a mono delay line sampled by four taps hardwired in pairs to the left and right outputs, plus a fifth tap that returns to the input

params.text: Sets the length of a beat in BPM, which every tap time is counted in
Sets the speed of the LFO that modulates the four main taps
Sets how far that modulation moves the times of the four main taps
Sets how hard the incoming signal is saturated, boosting what is below 9V and lowering what is above it
Sets the corner frequency of the two-pole low-pass filter, which has a fixed resonance, that the input passes through after saturation
Sets the delay time of that tap, counted in beats
Sets the delay time of the feedback tap, counted in beats
Sets the level of the tap 1 and 2 pair in the output mix
Sets the level of the tap 3 and 4 pair in the output mix
Sets the level of the feedback tap in the output mix
Sets the corner frequency of the two-pole high-pass filter at the output
Lowers the feedback tap while the incoming signal is loud, which allows high feedback levels without distortion
Sets the corner of the one-pole high-pass filter in the feedback tap, thinning each repeat
Sets the corner of the one-pole low-pass filter in the feedback tap, darkening each repeat
Sets how much of the feedback tap is returned to the input; that path is soft-clipped before it is mixed back in
Lowers the delayed signal at the output while the dry input is loud
Sets the balance between the dry input and the delayed signal
A three-position switch setting how the left and right inputs are combined into the mono delay line

inputs.text: A trigger or gate here sets the tempo, measured between rising edges, in place of the TEMPO knob
Modulates the modulation speed set by RATE
Modulates the modulation depth set by DEPTH
The left input, and the only one needed for a mono source
Modulates the corner frequency of the input low-pass filter set by LP
Modulates the input saturation set by DRIVE
Shifts the delay time of that tap by one beat per volt
Shifts the delay time of the feedback tap by one beat per volt
Modulates the level of the tap 1 and 2 pair
Modulates the level of the tap 3 and 4 pair
Modulates the level of the feedback tap
Modulates the corner of the low-pass filter in the feedback tap
Modulates the corner of the high-pass filter in the feedback tap
Modulates how much of the feedback tap is returned to the input
Modulates the corner frequency of the output high-pass filter
Modulates the dry-to-wet balance set by MIX

outputs.text: The left channel of the stereo output
The right channel of the stereo output

menu: PPQ — sets how many pulses at the clock input make one beat, which is what every tap time is counted in
